## What's Changed
* Update slf4j monorepo to v2.0.19 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/91
* Update dependency org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-surefire-plugin to v3.6.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/90
* Interactive workflow simulation and condition testing in the editor (#84) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/89
* Design spec: parallel execution — fork/join (concurrent branches) (#88) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/94
* Update dependency eslint to v10.10.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/95
* Update dependency node to v24.21.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/99
* Update dependency typescript-eslint to v8.70.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/98
* Update actions/setup-java digest to de7274f by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/100
* Parallel execution fork/join — Phases 1–3: Java engine, TypeScript parity, viewer/sim UI (#88) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/97
* Add visual workflow diff viewer and rich demo scenarios (#93) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/103
* Update dependency vite to v8.3.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/102
* Update react monorepo to v19.3.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/101
* Import/export of workflow definitions (including canvas image export) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/96


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/compare/v1.0.4...v2.0.0
